about: Capabilities in words. The console (components/capabilities/) and the faxbot command (faxbot savings capabilities, cli/commands/capabilities.py) show exactly what the server says. The response is GET /routing/capabilities evaluated on a synthetic installation (api/tests/test_capabilities.py scenario), and cli holds the lines the command prints from it: all of them, those ready to turn on, and some capabilities one by one. Its catalogue and capability fields must match app/routing/mechanisms.py and app/routing/capabilities.py. To rewrite it after either changes, run tests/test_capabilities.py with FAXBOT_WRITE_FIXTURES=1.

capabilities.sentence: Shows which of your Telnyx numbers pay for caller-name lookup, which Faxbot never uses, so you can turn it off.
capabilities.example: Telnyx charges for caller-name lookup on four of your numbers, which Faxbot never uses, so you can turn it off on each.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs your Telnyx key saved on the Telnyx page.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A Telnyx trunk.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Your Telnyx key, saved on the trunk page.

results.label: Delivery setup → Telnyx
results.command: faxbot delivery providers trunk telnyx names

capabilities.name: Lines and carrier closing dates
capabilities.sentence: Matches your fax lines to carriers' discontinuance lists and contract end dates, so you move a line before its price changes or it closes.
capabilities.example: Your carrier lists two of your fax lines for discontinuance next spring. The advice names them and their dates, so you can move them before the price changes or the lines close.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs your line inventory; none is imported yet.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Your line inventory, imported from your carrier or your own records.

capabilities.name: Copper closures
capabilities.sentence: Shows when the copper network under your French lines closes, commune by commune, so you move each line in time.
capabilities.example: The copper network under your Lyon office's commune closes in 2027. The advice shows the date for each line there, so you can move them in time.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: For phone lines in France; none of your sites has its commune set, and no line has a closing notice.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: For lines in France: each site's commune, or a line's closing notice.

capabilities.name: Fax server renewal
capabilities.sentence: Sets your fax server's renewal beside the channels it really used at peak and the faxes Faxbot already handles, so you renew only the channels you need.
capabilities.example: Your fax server's renewal quotes 24 channels, but its call records show at most 9 in use at once last year. The advice sets the two side by side, with the faxes Faxbot already handles, so you renew only the channels you need.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs your fax server's renewal or its call records; neither is entered yet.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Your fax server's renewal, or its call records to measure the channels it used at peak.

capabilities.name: Fax lines in a POTS-replacement order
capabilities.sentence: Works out what taking the fax lines out of a POTS-replacement quote removes from it, and what one shared trunk costs for them instead.
capabilities.example: Your carrier quotes a POTS-replacement order that includes eight fax lines. The advice shows what taking those lines out removes from the quote, and what one shared trunk would cost for them instead.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a POTS-replacement quote; none is entered yet.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Your carrier's POTS-replacement quote.

outcomes.title: Explain results and choose improvements
outcomes.sentence: Check what you were billed, and find the next change worth making.

capabilities.name: Charge checks
capabilities.sentence: Matches what your carriers and fax services billed against your faxes, and points out charges and invoice amounts your faxes don't explain.
capabilities.example: Your carrier's invoice lists three more calls than Faxbot recorded. Charges lists those three calls, so you can ask the carrier about them.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk.

capabilities.name: Suggested packs
capabilities.sentence: Gathers the settings and rules that would save money here into packs you review and apply.
capabilities.example: For a clinic with its own trunk, a pack gathers fax over IP, sending together and the page settings that suit it, for you to review and apply at once.

capabilities.name: Country service rules
capabilities.sentence: Shows the rules a country sets for fax services, with their sources, and which of your accounts you confirmed meet them.
capabilities.example: Your account with a provider in the United Arab Emirates is listed with that country's rules for fax services and their sources, and you record that the provider meets them.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: None of your accounts is in a country whose service rules Faxbot knows.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account in a country whose service rules Faxbot knows.

list: Capabilities
Everything Faxbot can do to make your faxes cost less and take less time, grouped by what it helps with.
Spend less on sending
Choose the route, plan or number that costs least for each fax.
Faxes to your own numbers (own_numbers): On · Works here · Sample data
Delivers a fax to one of your own numbers straight into Received, with no phone call.
Not used in 30 days
Approved toll-free numbers (toll_free): On · Works here · Sample data
Dials a recipient's toll-free fax number once they approve it; the recipient pays for those calls.
On for 1 recipient who approved a toll-free number.
Not used in 30 days
Cheapest route per delivered fax (cheapest_route): On · Not here · Sample data
Sends each number by the route that cost least per delivered fax once two routes have proven themselves.
On; a preferred route for a number still comes first.
Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.
Missing: Connection, Prices
Used on 2 faxes in 30 days
Your plan's faxes first (plan_first): On · Not here · Sample data
Uses a monthly plan while it has room under its budget, before routes that charge per fax.
Needs a monthly plan among your sending routes; you send through Telnyx only, with no plan.
Missing: Prices
Not used in 30 days
Cheaper routes per number (advice_sending): On · Not here · Sample data
Names numbers whose usual route cost more per delivered fax than another, with a button to switch.
Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.
Missing: Connection, Prices
Other carriers' prices (advice_carriers): On · Works here · Sample data
Prices your last 30 days of faxes at each carrier's published prices, so you can see what switching would change.
Calls just past a billed minute (advice_billing_steps): On · Works here · Sample data
Finds numbers whose calls end just past a billed minute, where one page less or a faster mode would cost less.
Toll-free numbers on file (advice_toll_free): On · Works here · Sample data
Lists recipients with a toll-free fax number, so you can record their approval and stop paying for those calls.
Fax marker on calls (advice_fax_marker): On · Works here · Sample data
Compares calls marked as fax with calls that were not, on delivery and cost per delivered fax.
Calls by state (advice_sites): On · Works here · Sample data
Says whether your carriers price US calls by state, and when another site's trunk would cost less.
Account chosen after measuring its pages (measured_account): On · Not here · Sample data
Measures the pages each of your sending accounts would really send, then sends by the account whose fax costs least.
Needs two or more sending accounts to compare; you send through Telnyx only.
Missing: Connection
Prices by the caller ID a call shows (caller_id_prices): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on
Prices each call by the caller ID it shows, where a carrier charges less for some caller IDs, so the cheapest route is chosen on the real price.
No prices that depend on the caller ID are imported yet.
Missing: Prices
Turn it on in Savings & optimization → Prices & plans.
Where Faxbot may dial (dialing_guard): On · Works here · Sample data
Holds a fax to a kind of number you have not allowed, such as premium-rate numbers or a new country, so no call is billed there by mistake.
Smaller documents and shorter calls
Send fewer pages, and keep each page on the line for less time.
Dense pages (dense_pages): On · Works here · Sample data
Stacks short pages onto longer fax pages where the receiving machine allows, and leaves out blank page bottoms, so fewer pages and seconds are billed.
Not used in 30 days
Encoded pages (experimental) (encoded_pages): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on · Experimental
Sends a whole document as a few dense fax pages that the recipient's Faxbot turns back into the original, for recipients who agreed.
No recipient has agreed to encoded pages yet.
Missing: Recipient's agreement
Not used in 30 days
Turn it on in Recipients.
Lighter shading (fax_friendly): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on
Lightens shaded areas and removes specks before a page goes on a line billed by time, so pages take less time to send.
Not used in 30 days
Turn it on in Delivery setup → Providers & accounts.
Fax over IP (T.38) (fax_over_ip): On · Works here · Live call
Carries fax pages as data over your SIP trunk, so pages go through faster than audio fax and calls are shorter.
Used on 3 calls in 30 days
Smallest page coding (measured_coding): On · Works here · Test lab
Measures each fax's pages in every coding the call may use and sends the smallest, so pages take less time on the line.
Not used in 30 days
Faster pages (sslfax): On · Not here · Test lab
Sends pages over SSL Fax when the other fax machine offers it, so calls take less time.
Needs Faxbot's fax engine, which starts when you select Apply and connect on the trunk page.
Missing: Fax engine
Not used in 30 days
Time lighter shading would save (advice_shading): On · Works here · Sample data
While Lighter shading is set to Never, measures your recent faxes and says how much time it would have saved.
Header notice instead of a cover page (header_notice): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on
Prints your notice in a band at the top of every page, so you can leave out the cover page and send one page fewer.
No header notice is set yet.
Missing: Setting
Turn it on in Delivery setup → Sending identity.
Avoid repeated calls and documents
Send what a recipient already has only once, and share calls where recipients agree.
Case packets (case_packets): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on
Leaves documents a recipient already accepted out of a case packet, so fewer pages are sent.
No recipient accepts a list of the documents they already have yet.
Missing: Recipient's agreement
Not used in 30 days
Turn it on in Recipients.
Direct delivery (direct_delivery): Off · Not here · Sample data
Sends documents to verified partners over the internet instead of placing a fax call.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner
Not used in 30 days
Fax images to partners (fax_images): Off · Not here · Sample data
Sends a partner the exact fax pages a call would carry, over the internet, with no phone call.
Off while direct delivery is off.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner, Setting
Not used in 30 days
Send once and reuse (reuse): Off · Not here · Sample data · Experimental
Sends a partner only what it lacks: one copy for several of its numbers, a reference to a document it already holds, or only the changes from the version it has.
Off while direct delivery is off.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner, Setting
Not used in 30 days
Sending together (sending_together): On · Works here · Test lab
Sends several short faxes to the same number in one call, on a line that charges for each call.
On for 1 recipient who agreed.
Not used in 30 days
Fewer separator pages (separator_pages): Off · Works here · Sample data · Ready to turn on
Marks each document in a shared call with an index page or a line on each page instead of a separator page.
No recipient has agreed to an index page or page marks yet.
Missing: Recipient's agreement
Not used in 30 days
Turn it on in Recipients.
Work better with regular recipients
Agree better ways to deliver with the organizations you fax most.
Partner fax over a private tunnel (partner_tunnel): Off · Not here · Test lab · Experimental
Places a fax call straight to a partner's fax engine inside your own encrypted tunnel, with no carrier and nothing per minute.
Off while direct delivery is off.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner, Partner, Setting
Not used in 30 days
Partner relays (relay): Off · Not here · Sample data
Sends faxes abroad through a partner that places them as local calls in its own country.
Off until you and a partner both sign a relay agreement.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner, Recipient's agreement
Not used in 30 days
Direct messages and FHIR (digital_routes): Off · Not here · Sample data
Delivers to a recipient's confirmed Direct address or FHIR server instead of placing a fax call.
No recipient has a confirmed Direct address or FHIR server yet.
Needs a Direct messaging (HISP) or FHIR account; none is set up yet.
Missing: Connection, Recipient's agreement
Not used in 30 days
Partner candidates (advice_partners): On · Works here · Sample data
Names the numbers whose faxes cost the most again and again, so you can enroll them as direct partners.
Recipients that run Faxbot (advice_discovery): On · Works here · Sample data
Finds recipients whose fax line is answered by a Faxbot, so you can send to them with no call.
Partners that could relay (advice_relays): On · Not here · Sample data
Names partners whose signed local price would have cost less than your own calls.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner
Registered senders (advice_registered_senders): On · Works here · Sample data
Sends a recipient that accepts faxes only from a registered number by the account and caller ID registered with it, so its faxes are not refused and sent again.
Recover delivery with less waste
Wait for the right moment, and resend only what is missing.
Calls at the right hour (busy_hours): On · Works here · Sample data
Waits out a number's usual busy hours when a failed call there could be charged.
On; urgent faxes still go at once.
Faxbot keeps no count of the faxes that waited
Wait for a free line (free_line): On · Works here · Sample data
Calls a number only while it has a free line, so a fax waits instead of paying for a busy call.
On; each number takes one call at a time unless you allow more.
Faxbot keeps no count of the faxes that waited
Only the missing pages (continuation): On · Works here · Sample data
Finishes a fax whose call broke by sending only the pages the call did not confirm.
On; you choose it for each fax whose call broke.
Not used in 30 days
Missing pages to partners (partner_repair): Off · Not here · Sample data · Experimental
After a broken call to a partner, sends only the pages the partner is missing, with no new call.
Off while direct delivery is off.
Needs a verified partner; you have none yet.
Missing: Partner, Setting
Not used in 30 days
Power-aware sending (power_aware): Off · Not here · Sample data
Starts a call only when your UPS has the runtime to finish it, so a power cut does not waste a call and its pages.
Needs a UPS that Faxbot reads through NUT; none is set.
Missing: Connection
50-second answer cap (answer_cap): On · Works here · Test lab
Hangs up a call that no fax machine answers within 50 seconds, on a trunk billed by the whole minute, so an unanswered call is not billed a second minute.
Its capped calls are not counted on Savings yet
Station check (station_check): On · Works here · Test lab
Compares the fax number the far machine shows with the number you dialled before any page, and says so in Sent details, or hangs up before any page where you choose, so a wrong number is caught.
What it caught is in each fax's Sent details, not on Savings
Keys after answer (keys_after_answer): Off · Works here · Test lab · Ready to turn on
Presses the keys a phone menu asks for before the fax machine answers, so a fax to a number behind a menu goes through instead of failing and being retried.
No recipient has keys to press after it answers yet.
Missing: Setting
The keys each call pressed are in its Sent details, not on Savings
Turn it on in Recipients.
Route problems told apart from number problems (route_problems): On · Works here · Sample data
Notices when calls through one route fail together, holds that route back and keeps the lesson off each number, so working numbers are not retried or abandoned for a route problem.
Lower receiving and service costs
Keep only the numbers, lines and plans you need, and turn away junk calls.
Junk callers turned away (blocked_senders): On · Works here · Sample data
Declines calls from blocked numbers before Faxbot answers, so they are never answered or received.
On for 1 number on your blocked list.
Turned away 1 call in 30 days

Says where each of your fax numbers costs least to receive on, and the steps to move it.

measured_account: Account chosen after measuring its pages
Measures the pages each of your sending accounts would really send, then sends by the account whose fax costs least.

For example: One of your accounts bills by the page and another by the minute. For a 12-page scan, Faxbot measures how long its pages would take on each and sends by the account whose bill for that fax is lower.
Needs two or more sending accounts to compare; you send through Telnyx only.
Helps with: Spend less on sending
Missing · Connection: A second sending route, such as another fax service account or your own SIP trunk. See Delivery setup → Providers & accounts.
Its setting: Delivery setup → Providers & accounts
Its figures: Faxes → Sent (faxbot faxes sent)
